<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 276.0666 (likely [M+H]⁺), the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈275.059 Da. Estimating the composition from the isotopic pattern (~15 C atoms) and fitting integer numbers of C, H, and O gives the best match with the formula C₁₅H₁₅O₅.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H15O5</final_answer>
